changes.change: 24 source functions: distribution numerical/guard core, shared type/recommendation functions and baseline classify-once helper. Private environments preserve the two different null-helper semantics. Full source20blob identities and function-level normalized hashes/patches are supplied.

Map all emitted source exceptions/suppression/finding codes to registered OS codes. Source text uses biological units instead of people; typed QC/finish are OmicStat. Original numerical code/tests retained separately for same-input native checks, not a runtime MedStat dependency.

Prespecified numerical function body remains identical after its function-name change. Optional source-advisory computes the copied heuristic and records recommended test text beside the actual chosen test. No eval/parse/automatic routing or multiplicity change.

Baseline classify-once helper accepts explicit continuous_vars, mirroring source classify_variable(force_type). Nonconstant two-valued numeric endpoints stay declared continuous instead of source automatic binary typing; constants stay constant. Paired pairwise advice classifies differences; pooled omnibus advice is explicitly not a residual/model validation.

Preserve n<20 conservative non-normal heuristic; otherwise abs(Fisher-Pearson g1)<=1 selects its normal branch. Shapiro/QQ are reference only. Source Shapiro cap5000/seed20250813/caller RNG restoration remain; do not substitute as a scientific proof or silently change actual methods.

Expose only source distribution_comparison as an explicit independent descriptive mode within the existing module. Require fixed reference/grid/minimum/unit/inference/dataset. Public weighted/joint/direct-standardization and categorical/survey baseline branches are not exposed.

Existing technical-repeat averaging and disjoint biological units apply before core. Preserve logical/censored/nonfinite source refusals before coercion. OmicStat missing-value refusal is stronger than original complete-case exclusion. Declared empty groups are retained and withheld; do not apply the old hypothesis-test minimum2 gate to descriptive suppression.

Original prespecified t contrasts stay group1-minus-group2. New distribution effects follow source other-group-minus-fixed-reference. Each table/metadata/figure says the direction; neither path is silently negated to match the other.

Keep source minimum10, cell/effective-n/tail/quantile-increment suppression, source average-unbiased-variance SMD and inverse-ECDF ties. New branch returns aggregate metrics/guardrails/spec only, with no unit table/raw ID/extrema/resample draws or small-n metadata bypass. Existing private hypothesis branch unchanged.

Keep original iid within-group bootstrap, explicit200..100000 attempts and finite fraction>=.95, fixed pointwise95%type7 percentile endpoints. No hidden truncation, constant-resample zero-width CI, simultaneous band, studentization or alternate estimator. Inactive source defaults under inference=none remain marked inactive.

Original raw P plus adjusted P, requested omnibus/pairwise membership and full declared family retained. Source baseline BT09 and add_q record policy are documented; no data-driven correction choice. Descriptive branch has no P family and no multiplicity-corrected CI; legacy required family-size1 is an interface placeholder, reported actual test count/family0.

Name previously positional original numerical arguments so OmicStat call registry can audit them. Existing stats4.5.0 formal observations retained as historical; added arguments have null/unverified defaults and require exact R4.6.1 capture. No installed-version or native-equivalence claim.

Display-only shared effect-interval builder draws precomputed mean/SMD/quantile contrasts with dataset labels, source row/hash binding, explicit missing/suppressed states and pagination14. Percentile CIs need not cover the original estimate; no widening/clipping. Whole-withheld pages have a status table, not fabricated plots. No MedStat theme/clinical journal/report layer.

Original6printed sleep anchors/real receipt and native fixture remain. Add10source numerical definitions,27copied distribution checks,31CLI refusal definitions and actual-entry/replay/aggregate-privacy/native figure tests. Synthetic-only fixture is prepared separately; cannot serve owner distribution review. No native tests executed here.

Native source equivalence/actual R4.6.1 formals/CLI and replay/typed output/figures/owner contact sheets remain pending; no Rscript/Docker here. New independent real owner dataset is not yet registered with verified source SHA. Preserve source research<20 evidence task and all other package gaps.

Preserve original parameter-guidance/restyle/resource source-freeze bytes and earlier revisions. New revisions7/4/2 bind only reviewed current changes. Error registry before bytes retained and reconstructed exactly after removing the explicit mapped B1 additions.

Existing sleep dataset definition/source SHA/owner receipt and six printed anchor objects unchanged. Only its anchors-file registration digest changes for ten appended synthetic source checks; whole prior registry and original anchors retained for exact reconstruction. No new real dataset registered or owner approval claimed.

Broad regression exposed a pre-existing incomplete Python renderer dispatch mock (missing Runner receipt fields and Pipeline.out). Fill the synthetic mock receipt, assert its exact log hash/image and keep the real render failure guard; no production renderer logic changed.

27 selected original source check blocks retained separately with exact hashes. OS error mapping plus binding original caller RNG seed19 to a variable for R lint are the only check-body adaptations; native execution remains pending.
